title: The Lean Startup: How Today's Entrepreneurs Use Continuous Innovation to Create Radically Successful Businesses
reason: The Lean Startup sits precisely at the intersection of software development and business strategy, which matches my dual background in software/AI and self-taught business. Its empirical, iterative framework appeals to my analytical decision-making style, and the emphasis on validated learning addresses my security-oriented preference for minimising irreversible risk before committing resources — a concern that is particularly salient given my relatively limited professional experience of zero to two years.
